Spikes correctly track the level-2 all-in blowup on a fragile, escapeless Senna and the late-game soul-stack hypercarry flip.

edits.after: Senna is fragile with no escape at level 1 — trade autos hard, she has no answer yet.

edits.after: Your W-Q all-in blows her up before her Piercing Darkness poke matters here.

edits.before: - Senna Last Embrace (Root): matchup-defining — The root spreads to nearby targets — stand off your own minions and carry. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Senna Last Embrace (W): 11s cooldown, root spreads to nearby targets — stand off your own minions, then all-in while it's down. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
